annotation.title_clean: Εθνική Στρατηγική για την Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη (ΤΝ) της Κυπριακής Δημοκρατίας – Cyprus National AI Strategy 2032: A Strategic Blueprint
annotation.title_en: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence of the Republic of Cyprus – Cyprus National AI Strategy 2032: A Strategic Blueprint
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Republic of Cyprus (Government of Cyprus, e-consultation)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Draft Cyprus National AI Strategy to 2032, put out for public e-consultation. It aims to make Cyprus a trusted AI hub in the Eastern Mediterranean. It covers data, governance and controls, public-sector adoption, priority sectors, skills, compute, research, ethics, KPIs and alignment with the EU AI Act. Embodied AI appears only as a research focus area (autonomous systems).
key_provisions_or_claims: Vision: by 2032 Cyprus is the leading trusted AI hub in the Eastern Mediterranean.
Creates a National AI Authority and a National AI Taskforce to govern and monitor implementation.
Risk-based governance with use-case lifecycle control gates and AI Officers in public bodies.
Recommends ISO 42001/27001 to support EU AI Act compliance.
Eight priority sectors, including government, finance, healthcare, tourism, legal, education, shipping and entrepreneurship; research focus includes autonomous systems.
